data.name: Outcity
data.detailed_description:
PLAY THE DEMO


About the Game

Welcome to Outcity!

Outcity is a cozy sandbox farm simulator where creativity grows as freely as the crops you plant. Start fresh in the countryside, transform untamed lands into your dream homestead, and build a thriving community from the ground up.

🌱 Build your dream farm from scratch on wild, untamed lands.
💬 Assign villagers to help farm, gather, defend, and grow your settlement.
🗺️ Explore vast biomes and unlock new regions filled with unique resources.
💀 Experience light nighttime raids as mischievous skeletons target your farm.
💎 Discover rare treasures in endlessly generated underground caves.
🎣 Fish in tranquil lakes and collect rare catches.
🏡 Customize every detail of your homestead with total creative freedom.
✨ Unlock over 140 upgrades across farming, fishing, construction, automation, combat, and more!

Build Without Limits

Create anything you can imagine, from a cozy cottage garden to a sprawling countryside metropolis. Tidy layouts, artistic designs, creative chaos — every path, field, and decoration is yours to shape. Outcity gives you the freedom to express your style and build the countryside world you've always imagined.

Explore and Expand Across Unique Biomes

Your journey will take you through lush meadows, arid hillsides, and fertile lowlands. Each region offers exclusive crops, valuable resources, and new opportunities for expansion. Venture into fresh territories, discover what the land has to offer, and let your creativity shape every corner of the map.

Grow Through Deep and Meaningful Progression

The land is alive — and as you learn to care for it, your world grows with you. Outcity features over 140 upgrades spanning farming, fishing, construction, automation, exploration, and light combat. Each one enriches the way you plant, build, gather, and defend, creating a natural sense of progression that unfolds as you play.
Experiment with soil types, irrigation systems, and planting strategies to help your farm flourish, or unwind with peaceful fishing and quiet exploration in search of hidden secrets scattered throughout the valley.

A Living Community That Works With You

As your farm expands, the valley fills with life. The townsfolk who settle nearby aren’t just decoration — they’re part of your world. Build relationships, enjoy light moments of flirtation, and assign villagers to help with farming, harvesting, gathering, and even protecting your land. Their support adds a relaxed layer of strategy and helps your settlement feel like a true community growing together.

A Peaceful Valley… Most of the Time

When night falls and the valley grows quiet, mischievous skeletons begin to wander. Some appear tucked into hidden corners of the world, while others emerge near your farm, targeting crops, fences, and anything left unguarded. They’re more playful than terrifying, but they bring just enough trouble to keep evenings interesting.

Choose how you want to handle them: defend your homestead with crafted tools, rely on helpful villagers to fight alongside you, or stay safely indoors until morning if you prefer a quieter night. 

Uncover Treasures and Rare Resources

Beneath Outcity’s peaceful farmland lies a vast network of endlessly generated caves, each one deeper and more rewarding than the last. Venture underground to uncover legendary seeds, powerful tools, precious minerals, and ancient artifacts hidden throughout mysterious caverns.
Every trip underground opens new possibilities for growth, creativity, and adventure.

This is Outcity

Your refuge. Your pace. Your world.
No pressure. Just creation, exploration, and the satisfaction of building something that's genuinely yours!

data.short_description: Tired of big city life, you move to Outcity to start fresh in the countryside. Build your farm your way in a cozy sandbox where imagination has no limits and friendly villagers help your homestead grow into a thriving village. Gather your determination, your creativity, and get to work!
